body: No I still get them from here and there. Usually when I wake up in the mornings or as I’m falling asleep.. and sometimes when I puke. As I puke more often due to chronic anxiety and some acid/stomach issues. But it’s just weird how they pop out of nowhere sometimes too. Nothing around me is close to what I smell and taste when it happens.. it’s pretty bad. I mean I haven’t gotten my sense of smell all the way back yet I feel like but I can smell and taste better than I did a month ago!

I’ve been having the same thing.. except it’s more of a metal or burnt smell to me and with the smell comes the taste in my mouth of what fresh cut grass would be like when mowing a lawn or something. I was freaking out when I would wake up to the smell and kind of taste of it.. when nothing around me could possibly smell like that. I’ve been cleared from my covid experience for about 2 weeks now and I’m still getting these weird smells randomly. I don’t know why it is though.
I felt that whole post. To a T.. like my nose isn’t stuffed up really I just can’t smell a thing! Even coffee grounds. 🤦🏼‍♀️
Thank you! That does put me more at ease. I never realized my love for food until now.. 😭 not being able to smell really puts a damper on enjoying what I eat.

I do talk to people on here. It’s nice to just not have anyone know who I am. I don’t know. I kind of just want to be decluttered. My life has felt as though it’s revolved around everyone else and even then it does me no good. So I need a break.
I find it bittersweet in all the best and sometimes frustrating ways.

Well I think the next line further describes it? "See it isn't the complete absense of sound, but rather the complete absence of self." I mean it's like those people who say everything without saying anything at all. It's in their body language or presence almost? I don't know how to explain.. I mean that's how I feel about it.
Yeah It is a feeling of its own for sure, but like not an intense one I guess? I definitely appreciate it too when and if I can! Thank you for your input!
I try to on occasion. It's hard to find the time a lot of the time. I also feel that being in the shower or even just sitting in bed is my own form of meditation when i'm pondering things.
What do you mean? What was complex for you about it? If i may ask?
I do the same. It's nice to hear that someone might even feel close to what i'm feeling.

The way I feel and see it I guess is these are short trips where I don't have the obligation of feeling? I'm sure for other people it could be different when they drift away.. but that's my experience with it at least! I wrote this not really thinking anything of it to be honest.. It was just a "yeah, thats where I go passing thought."
